gen-gf-baloo-da-2-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders. Fauna One lets Baloo Da 2 do the shouting, its lowercase standing almost cap-tall and its s terminals spread wide.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, its big counters and unclosed curves giving a tall lowercase plenty of room. But Baloo Da 2 above it is all bold command, its lowercase standing almost cap-tall.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-gf-graduate: Graduate feels dignified and bookish, with generous white between letters and almost no gap between capital and lowercase height. And Baloo Da 2 sets a bold, commanding voice above, so a loud top meets a dignified body.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads traditional and refined, a serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on its s. Baloo Da 2 above it supplies all the muscle, bold and commanding.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-gf-kadwa: Lowercase standing almost cap-tall gives Baloo Da 2 its commanding punch, over Kadwa's open-ended curves and larger-than-usual x-height. Baloo Da 2 earns its keep when it runs big and short.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, with lowercase filling most of the letter height. And Baloo Da 2 above it is bold and commanding, its own lowercase nearly cap-tall too.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-gf-pridi: Pridi reads classic and refined, leaving generous space between curve ends and stems while its small letters stand nearly capital-sized. Then Baloo Da 2 shouts over it, bold and commanding with s terminals set wide.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and editorial, Suwannaphum has a c as open as a bent paperclip and an x-height reaching high. But Baloo Da 2 is the louder voice, bold and commanding, its lowercase almost cap-tall.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab reads classic and dignified, with tall rounded lowercase forms and a c that gapes visibly at any size. Epunda Slab gives Baloo Paaji 2 a worthy partner, since that heading has its own towering lowercase.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-gf-glegoo: A towering lowercase that stays held open rather than curled shut defines Baloo Paaji 2, bold and commanding up top. And Glegoo meets that openness with refined, editorial curves and big counters of its own.
